GHSA-qr28-fpjm-wq7f.notes: decode-uri-component 0.2.2 carries the single-pass UTF-8 decoder from upstream 0.5.1 (58ed85f5adc7cfaee5e49e4d52b067f172d0bcb6), backported with patch-package while preserving the CommonJS/plus-sign API required by Expo Router's query-string 7. Upgrading directly to 0.5.1 would change its module/API contract. CI and postinstall run test:security against every locked decoder, including malformed-input timeout regressions. npm audit cannot detect this patch. Remove the patch and exception when the Expo dependency chain accepts a fixed decoder; review by 2026-11-13.
